summary: Bench bumped 0.29.2 -> 0.30.2 and H3 nodes verified registered; the open question is feasibility, not wiring. Smallest usable weight set is 53.9 GB against 53.7 GB free on G: and 16 GB VRAM on the 4060 Ti. Engine stays pinned at 0.29.2 until this card returns a go.

Picked up for bench research. Storage moves off G: to C:/AI (205.8 GB free), so the 53.7 GB ceiling in the brief no longer binds. Weight matrix, variant meanings and the turbo-LoRA question researched; a UK licence exclusion surfaced as the real blocker.

Maturity corrected from 'research' to 'in-progress'. The card was moved todo -> doing, and 'research' is a todo-only value: doing allows only in-progress or validating. Scope is unchanged - this stays an investigation card, which the title, description and acceptance carry.

Licence blocker analysed against the full text: the UK/EU/US/KR carve-out covers Outputs too, so watermarking buys nothing and free/open-source buys nothing. Not re-hosting the weights is the one real mitigation. A formal licence request was prepared; details are held outside this repo.

MiniMax H3 licence route resolved: MiniMax runs an official request form for excluded territories, linked from docs/QA-about-License.md in the H3 repo. A request was submitted 2026-08-05 and authorization was granted the same day. Request and approval details are held outside this repo under a confidentiality undertaking. Consequence for the app: a user consent gate in front of the H3 download is required before H3 can ship.

UMBRELLA SCOPE, decided by the user: no separate card for the engine bump. MPI-449 owns the whole H3 arc - bench research, the go/no-go, then running MPI-451 (licence gate) and bumping the engine 0.29.2 -> 0.30.x, before handing to MPI-452 for model wiring. Fresh sessions carry state via mpi-handoff. Progress: all five weight files downloaded to C:/AI and checksum-verified; encoder is ethanfel's abliterated int8 26.36 GB (complete vision tower kept in BF16) over Comfy-Org's 27.14 GB, with int4 rejected on ApacheOne's published 18-19 percent worst-layer RMSE that also hits the vision tower. H3 RUNS on the 4060 Ti 16 GB - 131 s warm, 20 steps, 640x640 x 56 frames, 6.55 s/step - which answers acceptance criterion 1. MINIMAX_H3_RATIOS shipped to js/utils/ratios.js in commit f739e076, inert until a ModelDef references it. The 0.30.0 node floor is now recorded as a hard second gate on MPI-452. BLOCKED: a Cubric-Prompt agent is running prompt-enhancement tests with Ollama on the same GPU, so every timing is an upper bound and the clean re-run waits on it.

note: Built the two-stage latent staging nodes in the sibling repo c:/AI/Mpi/ComfyUi-MpiNodes (new latent.py, registered in __init__.py, README + changelog). MpiSaveLatent writes <output>/latents/<name>.latent and gates downstream with the same continue/block boolean as MpiBlocker; MpiLoadLatent reads it back and continues. Core SaveLatent crashes on an H3 latent because NestedTensor has no .contiguous(), so the pair is split with unbind() into latent_tensor_0/1 and rebuilt on load. comfy.nested_tensor is imported inside the function, never at module scope, so the pack still loads on the app engine at 0.29.2. Single-tensor files stay byte-compatible with core LoadLatent. Verified by a round-trip harness under the bench python: H3-shaped pair, plain tensor, core LoadLatent reading our file, missing-file blocker and the path helper all pass. Live registration on the bench still needs a ComfyUI restart. These nodes are generic (they would clean up the WAN workflow too) and were folded under MPI-449 rather than carded.

Session close-out. Two-stage H3 sampling PROVED: SplitSigmas 5/15 plus a latent round-tripped through disk is bit-for-bit equal to a single-stage run, +1.4 s (+4%). Four nodes shipped to ComfyUi-MpiNodes and pushed (HEAD fd9bdca): MpiSaveLatent, MpiLoadLatent, MpiBooleanInvert, MpiH3Length, plus a lazy-input fix to MpiBlocker. Structural finding, now in docs/workflow-authoring/mpi-nodes.md: ExecutionBlocker only travels downstream and an OUTPUT_NODE is always executed, so gating after a sampler never stopped the sampler - which is why the wan22 _stage2 twins exist with Stage1_Bypass deleted. Both forcing paths are now fixable with lazy gates, so those twins can likely go (LTX six differ by ONE baked boolean). H3 cannot produce whole seconds: n%17==5 at 24 fps means 2 s is really 2.33 s (56 frames, measured on a real mp4); 8 s is the shortest exact one. H3 does not repeat frames (56 decoded, 56 unique), so the WAN/LTX remove-frame node is unnecessary. App seek needs no change - MpiVideoControlBar derives effFps from frameCount/duration. OPEN RISK: every measurement on this card ran at 56 frames and the trained range is 124-362, so the 5-step preview floor, the pruned/unpruned A/B and the timing table are all provisional - re-run at 124 before they become tier defaults. Card stays doing/in-progress.
